recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, centered torso shot of a heavily tattooed male figure against a deep red, atmospheric background. The subject is rendered in desaturated monochrome, emphasizing skin texture, surgical scars, and intricate ink work, while wearing prominent iced-out diamond chains and a watch. A thin black bar at the top contains spaced-out typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Monochrome subject against a saturated red background for maximum pop
Symmetry between the centered torso and the horizontal text bar
Texture contrast between smooth diamond surfaces and detailed skin ink
Vertical alignment of the surgical scar and the central jewelry pendants
coreInvariants: Desaturated, high-contrast black and white skin tones
Deep crimson red background with subtle smoke or ember effects
Prominent display of iced-out jewelry with realistic light glints

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered, medium close-up of the torso from waist to neck, filling 70% of the frame width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The diamond pendants at the center of the chest act as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bright jewelry, moves down the surgical scar to the hands, then upward to the text bar at the top edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep red void surrounding the silhouette of the torso.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation background vs. zero saturation subject; high value highlights on jewelry.

composition.position: Top edge inside a black horizontal bar

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family with color variation for emphasis.
graphicDevices: Parental advisory sticker in bottom right

candidateDirections.reason: Clean geometric structure matches the modern urban feel.
Open counters and geometric shapes work well with wide tracking.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white photo of a muscular man's torso covered in tattoos, including a visible surgical scar on the abdomen. He is wearing heavy diamond chains. Place this against a dark red background with subtle red smoke and sparks. Include a solid black horizontal bar at the very top.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase geometric sans-serif text inside the top black bar. Use extreme letter spacing. Color the central words in red and the outer words in white.

verificationChecks: Is the background a deep, saturated red?
Is the text tracking extremely wide?
Is the jewelry rendered with bright white highlights?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the surgical scar is a central vertical element
Verify the top black bar is perfectly horizontal
Check that the red background has depth and isn't a flat color
Confirm the jewelry looks metallic and reflective
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochrome gritty subject + Saturated colored background + Top-aligned wide-tracked typography = Urban Gritty Aesthetic.
